verdicts.explanation: The paper states 'The ionic conductivity of 12 mS/cm and 17 mS/cm was obtained for model 1 and model 2' for the Li1.0AlO0.75Cl2.5 3x3x3 MLIP-based MD models run at 300 K, so the material, value, unit, temperature and computational origin all match, and the secondary fields are null.

The same sentence gives 17 mS/cm for model 2, which the paper describes as direct MLIP-based MD at 300 K on the expanded Li1.0AlO0.75Cl2.5 structure; the computational origin and null secondary fields are correct.
The introduction attributes the 2.42 mS cm−1 room-temperature conductivity of Li1.75ZrCl4.75O0.5 to Hu et al. [24], so literature_cited is correct and the value, unit and temperature match.
The introduction attributes the ~1 mS cm−1 room-temperature conductivity of Li1.0AlO0.75Cl2.5 to Dai et al. [26], so literature_cited is correct and the value and unit match the paper.
